##: The source of lulu-loopp/scoop-folio's bucket/folio.json. scripts/release/update-manifests.ps1 renders it for a release (version, url, hash, extract_dir) and commits the result to the bucket.

post_install writes folio-install.json, the install channel marker Folio reads at start: this copy is scoop's, and scoop runs Folio's cleanup when it uninstalls it. scoop runs post_install at every install and update, into the new version folder, so every version folder carries its own marker.

pre_uninstall runs 'folio --uninstall-cleanup' on 'scoop uninstall' only. scoop also runs pre_uninstall on 'scoop update', and the cleanup removes what Folio set up outside its folder (the right-click menu, agent hooks, the PowerShell profile line), which an update must keep; $cmd is scoop's own name for the command being run. Exit 2 means a Folio is running and nothing was changed: the hook throws, and scoop stops with the app intact. Exit 1 means one removal was refused: the uninstall goes on, and the lines above say what stayed.
description: Terminal that typesets formulas where a command prints them, with files previewed beside the prompt
pre_uninstall: if ($code -eq 2) { throw "$($cleanup -join ' ') scoop did not uninstall Folio. Close Folio, then run 'scoop uninstall folio' again." }
if ($code -ne 0) { Write-Host "Folio's cleanup ended with exit code $code; the lines above say what stayed." }
notes: The Explorer right-click entry ("Open in Folio") is switched on from inside Folio:
the first-run card, or Settings > General. It keeps working across 'scoop update'.
'scoop uninstall folio' removes it, and everything else Folio set up outside its folder. Your settings are kept.
